description: LukeEvansTech shared Renovate config — home-operations/renovate-presets plus house defaults. Consume it from any repo with: extends: ["github>LukeEvansTech/renovate-config"].

packageRules.description: Auto-merge minor/patch everywhere after a 2-day soak — CI-gated PR merge. platformAutomerge:false means Renovate self-gates on CI and self-merges, so no branch-protection ruleset is needed, and repos with zero CI checks never auto-merge (Renovate requires ignoreTests:true to merge without tests). Majors never match any rule here, so they always stay manual. Repos add their own protected-package denylist (automerge:false, last-match-wins) for anything that must stay human-reviewed.

Auto-merge digest and pin updates — CI-gated, deliberately NO minimumReleaseAge: mutable-tag digest bumps reset the age clock on every upstream rebuild and GHCR often has no per-digest timestamp, so an age gate leaves digest PRs pending forever (talos-cluster had 11 pending up to 19 days).

GitHub Actions minor/patch/digest merge as a branch (no PR at all when clean; a failure surfaces as a PR). Action refs are SHA-pinned semver via the base preset, and a broken workflow bump shows up on its next run on main.
mise tool bumps minor/patch merge as a branch, same rationale as GitHub Actions above.

Terraform/Terragrunt-managed deps never auto-merge: in the codelooks-com IaC repos a merge to main auto-applies via CD, so provider/module bumps stay human-reviewed. Actions and mise bumps in those repos still auto-merge via the rules above.
